text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! This is where the trophies<n>you've
acquired from races are<n>displayed!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Proposition! I want you to win every race<n>and fill
this room with prizes!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Dream big! Don't stop until all the<n>trophies are
yours!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I want to see this place absolutelycrammed wall-to-wall with glimmeringtrophies!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I wish for the success of all<n>our
Umamusume here at Tracen<n>Academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, accruing many trophies<n>brings more
rewards. So be sure to check<n>your missions often!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For my dream and the future of our<n>Umamusume,
I'm counting on you!
